description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named `CameraPreview` that manages camera hardware, handles switching between cameras, and displays a live camera feed using a custom `Preview` ViewGroup which manages a SurfaceView for rendering the camera preview. It includes camera setup, resource management, user interaction via menu options, and camera preview display logic.

classes.name: CameraPreview
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages camera hardware, handles user interaction for switching cameras, and displays the camera preview.

classes.name: Preview
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that contains a SurfaceView to show the camera preview, handling camera setup, surface lifecycle, and preview size adjustments.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and determines default camera ID.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Opens the camera and initializes the preview when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases the camera resource when the activity is paused.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu for camera controls.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles user interaction with menu options, particularly switching cameras.
